summary: Verified two visual changes on /communities-next per iteration_23 follow-up: (1) region tab labels no longer truncate — all 13 tabs render full text with scrollWidth == clientWidth (truncated=False); (2) region section band images now use distinct landscape photos for the 9 required regions, with Cariboo/Central Coast/Haida Gwaii sharing the acceptable BC default. Live weather chips render on all 12 regions. Filtering, search, clear, and empty state all still work. No horizontal page overflow at either 1920px or 390px; on mobile the tab strip becomes a horizontal scroller (overflowX=auto, innerScrollW=1622px, container=358px) with no page-level overflow. Desktop wraps to two rows cleanly.

verification_details.filtering: Clicking communities-region-okanagan hides all other sections (visible sections = ['communities-section-okanagan']); clicking All restores all 12 sections.
verification_details.search: Search 'Kelowna' filters cards; clear button restores list; 'zzzzznotarealplace' shows empty state ('No communities found. Try a different spelling, or clear the search to see all 240 profiles. Show all communities').

overflow.desktop_1920: doc=1920 win=1920 (no overflow, tabs wrap to 2 rows)
overflow.mobile_390: doc=390 body=390 win=390 (no overflow); tab strip inner scrollWidth=1622 overflowX=auto flex-wrap=nowrap (clean horizontal scroll)

verification_details.subjective_apple_read: Looks clean and Apple-like: generous whitespace, large serif+sans headline, pill segmented control, hero-band imagery with subtle live weather chip, tidy card grid. Two-row tab wrap on desktop is orderly. Only very minor nit: the '240 communities' count sits floating to the right of the tab block on desktop — could benefit from vertical alignment to the first tab row, but not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Three regions (Haida Gwaii, Central Coast, Cariboo) share the same Unsplash photo-1502920917128 as BC default — acceptable per spec, but consider swapping in unique thumbnails later for visual variety.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both visual changes from iteration_23 follow-up are confirmed: (a) tab labels are no longer ellipsised (verified via scrollWidth==clientWidth for all 13 tabs and by reading full text); (b) 9 regions use distinct band photos while Cariboo/Central Coast/Haida Gwaii intentionally share BC default. Live weather works (open-meteo). No regressions in filter/search/clear/empty flows. Mobile tab strip scrolls horizontally without causing page overflow.
